title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
goal: 400 points: get through the worst day of Arthur Dent's life
intro: You're playing The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, Infocom's 1984 game written by Douglas Adams, with your hhgg tools. You're Arthur Dent, waking up in the dark with a hangover on the worst day of your life. It's famously tricky and silly: replies that look like errors are often jokes and clues, so read them, try odd things, and come back to what didn't work. 400 points is a perfect score. FOOTNOTE 1 reads a footnote when the game mentions one. Don't panic.
feel: it's absurd and unfair and very British; laugh at it
